mentions.name: Arduino implementation of Reticulum
mentions.description: An Arduino implementation of the Reticulum network protocol, still early and needing more testing. A node's address is the hash of its public key, which can be announced on the network or not.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I started working on a Arduino implementation, but it needs more testing.

It works like your address is the hash of your pubkey, and you can announce that or not.
